name: VOIDLOG.GG-Client
description: VOIDLOG.GG Client - Star Citizen Kill Feed Monitor
author: VOIDLOG.GG Team

scripts.test:bodycam: esbuild test/bodycam/bodycam.test.ts test/bodycam/bodycam-window.test.ts test/bodycam/bodycam-live.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outdir=test/bodycam/.out --out-extension:.js=.mjs && node --test test/bodycam/.out/bodycam.test.mjs test/bodycam/.out/bodycam-window.test.mjs test/bodycam/.out/bodycam-live.test.mjs
scripts.test:settings-inputs: vite build --config scripts/overlay-preview/vite.config.ts --outDir ../../test/settings-inputs/.out --emptyOutDir --logLevel warn && electron test/settings-inputs/run.cjs
scripts.test:overlay: esbuild test/overlay/overlay.test.ts test/overlay/overlay-socket.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outdir=test/overlay/.out --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=warning && node --test test/overlay/.out/overlay.test.mjs test/overlay/.out/overlay-socket.test.mjs
scripts.release: npm run build && electron-builder --dir --publish never && npm run smoke:packaged && electron-builder --publish always
